item.tib: byang chub kyi spyod pa la 'jug pa'i dka' 'grel
item.skt: bo d+hi tsAr+ya a ba tA ra pany+tsi kA
item.coloph: byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i 'grel bshad las sher rab le'u'i rgya cher bshad pa/ dge slong mkhas pa shes rab 'byung gnas blo gros kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i grel bshad las le'u dang po gnyis dang brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab kyi Ti kA mkhas pa chen po su ma ti kIrti dang / lo tsA ba dar ma grags kyis bsgyur ba'o/ dbu ru byang phyogs lcung ka mkhar grags su mkhas pa chen po blo gros bzang grags pa/ ldong stong macho gnas rgya sgo mched grogs kyis/ gsol btab dge slong dar ma grags kyis bsgyur
